Cristiano Ronaldo is reportedly considering leaving Saudi Arabian side Al-Nassr in the summer, with a return to Europe or a move to the MLS considered potential options.  The 40-year-old, who, on a contract worth £488,000 per day, is the highest-paid footballer in history, began a strike earlier this week.   Ronaldo is claimed to unhappy with the manner in which Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) is handling Al-Nassr's finances, particularly in comparison to how they are treating rival clubs. The PIF controls a 75 per cent stake in four Saudi Pro League clubs — Al-Ahli, Al-Ittihad, Al-Hilal and Ronaldo's Al-Nassr — and has been the driving force behind the league's ability to attract some of world football's biggest names on lucrative contracts.   Al-Hilal completed the signing of Ronaldo's former Real Madrid team-mate Karim Benzema on Monday, moving from fellow Saudi Arabian side Al-Ittihad.    Al-Hilal are currently one point clear of Ronaldo's Al-Nassr in the Saudi Pro League, with the veteran Portuguese star said to believe his club have not been treated fairly in the transfer market. According to Portuguese newspaper Record, Ronaldo's frustration has led to him considering leaving Al-Nassr in the summer.   The report claims Ronaldo has a £43million (€50m) release clause, with the veteran having 18 months to run on a two-year deal he signed last summer.  It remains to be seen whether any club would look to trigger the release clause, given Ronaldo is set to turn 41 on Thursday.  It is claimed that a return to Europe or a move to the MLS could be possible options for Ronaldo.  In December, Ronaldo hinted at a possible return to Europe as he reiterated his ambition to reach 1,000 career goals. #ronaldo #cristiano #cr7 #football #long

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Spicy Brazilian-style coconut chicken with tender chicken thighs, creamy coconut sauce, and a hint of lime and cilantro. Comfort food with a tropical twist🥥 I hope you’ll give it a try ❤️ Ingredients (2-3 person) For the Spicy Coconut Chicken •	14 oz/400 g chicken thighs, boneless  •	Salt and freshly cracked black pepper •	Juice of ½ lime •	1 tsp paprika •	chili flakes (adjust to taste) •	0,5 tsp cayenne (adjust to taste) •	olive oil For the Sauce •	1 small onion, chopped •	3 garlic cloves, minced •	1 red bell pepper, sliced •	2 medium sized tomato  chopped  •	1 tbsp tomato paste •	1 can coconut milk / 400 ml / 13.5 oz •	½ tsp turmeric •	1 tsp paprika or smoked paprika for a more smookey flavor  •	0,5 tsp cumin  To Serve •	White or coconut rice •	Lime wedges for garnish •	fresh cilantro, chopped  •	Optional: fresh red chili, for extra heat Instructions 1.	Season the chicken: Mix chicken with lime juice, salt, pepper, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne (optional), and olive oil. Let sit 10-15 min. 2.	Sear the chicken: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken thighs and sear 6-8 min per side until golden. Remove and set aside. 3.	Build the sauce: In the same pan, sauté onion until soft (3-4 min). Add garlic and cook 30 sec. Stir in bell pepper, tomato, tomato paste, and spices, cooking 2-3 min until fragrant. 4.	Add coconut milk: Pour in the full can, stir, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook a few min until slightly thickened. 5.	Finish the chicken: Return chicken to pan. Simmer 5-10 min or until fully cooked and sauce is creamy. Stir in cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning or spice. 6.	Serve: Plate chicken with sauce over a generous portion of rice. Garnish with extra cilantro and lime wedges. ¡Tensión Extrema! Abuela Cae en la Guarida del Tigre y Su Hija Salta para Salvarla en un Zoológico de Pesadilla ​ ​¡Quedó a centímetros de las garras! Lo que debía ser un día de paseo familiar se convirtió en una pesadilla de alto riesgo. Una mujer de la tercera edad experimentó el pánico absoluto al desplomarse la baranda de seguridad, cayendo en picada directamente al recinto de un imponente tigre adulto. El estruendo de la caída y los gritos de horror de los visitantes inundaron el lugar. En un acto de valentía desesperada, su hija no lo dudó: saltó al foso para interponerse entre su madre y el depredador. El enorme felino, una mole de músculo y dientes, las observaba a escasos metros. Contra todo pronóstico, y en un desenlace milagroso, ambas salieron ¡totalmente ilesas! La rápida y audaz intervención de los cuidadores, que lograron distraer al animal y activar de inmediato el protocolo de emergencia, evitó una tragedia. El impactante suceso dejó a todos los presentes en estado de shock y desató una tormenta de críticas sobre las alarmantes fallas de seguridad y el mantenimiento del zoológico.

What ever happened to Ronaldo's famous freekick technique? From 2006-2014, he was undoubtedly the world's best set piece taker, however that all changed very suddenly... Part of it? Bad luck. The other? FIFA.  In 2014, after the Jabulani World Cup fiasco, NASA concluded football's were too round. So, Adidas and Nike both reinvented the ball, making Ronaldo's signature knuckleball technique considerably harder. Worse still, that same season Ronaldo suffered a serious knee injury that dramatically reduced the speed of his swing: tendinosis. For CR7 to knuckle the redesigned football's, he'd have to strike them much harder, which all of a sudden he could no longer do.  Since then, he's scored just 6 total freekicks on 150 attempts, bringing his overall record to 4%. Through that same stretch, Lionel Messi is averaging 9.3%, as his curveball technique became considerably more effective. Although we rarely see Ronaldo's signature freekicks these days, it's hard to argue he's not the greatest freekick taker ever, although "the best" likely belongs to someone else. Recipe Name Loaded Beef Nacho Casserole Ingredients 1. 1 large bag (13–15 oz) tortilla chips 2. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 3. 1 small onion, finely diced 4. 2 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 6. 1/3 cup water 7. 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend 8. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 9. 1 cup diced tomatoes 10. 1/3 cup diced pickled jalapeños 11. 1/2 cup salsa 12. 1/2 cup sour cream (for serving) 13. 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro 14. 1 tbsp olive oil 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion until soft. 3. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, then drain any excess grease. 5. Stir in the taco seasoning, water, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until thickened. 6. Spread half of the tortilla chips in the baking dish. 7. Top with half of the seasoned beef, half of the salsa, and half of both cheeses. 8. Repeat with the remaining chips, beef, salsa, and cheese. 9. Bake for 12–15 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly. 10. Remove from the oven and immediately top with diced tomatoes and jalapeños. 11. Garnish with chopped cilantro. 12. Serve hot with sour cream, guacamole, or extra salsa if desired. Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep—just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients * 4 chicken breasts * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Oregano * 1 jar pesto * 6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended) * Fresh tomato slices * Fresh basil * Balsamic glaze ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake (or broil) for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, fresh basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Serves: 4–6 Ingredients * 2 lbs chicken (thin-cut breasts, regular breasts, diced chicken, or boneless skinless thighs) * 1 (7.5 oz) tub Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese * ½ cup jalapeño jelly * ½ cup chicken broth * 3 tbsp ranch seasoning * Shredded mozzarella or pepper jack cheese Garnish with bacon crumbles or fresh parsley! Chicken Seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Place the chicken in the baking dish 4. Season the chicken with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. 5. In a bowl, whisk together:     * Softened Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese     * Jalapeño jelly     * Chicken broth     * Ranch seasoning 6. Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake according to the times below. 8. Remove from oven the last 5-10 minutes. take off foil, and top with shredded cheese. Place back in oven to melt cheese. Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

videos.caption: 12/10 on flavor for this one. 🔥 @NicoleMcLaughlin is back with your easy dinner this week: Mississippi Chicken Casserole. It’s cheesy and creamy, and has that punch of flavor from the pepperoncini peppers that really takes it to the next level. Get the recipe below or tap the link in @allrecipes bio to try it for yourself! 🍽️ Ingredients:  4 ounces cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1/4 cup brine from pepperoncini peppers 1 (1-ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (1-ounce) package au jus gravy mix 1 cup milk 3 cups wide egg noodles (6 ounces), cooked according to package directions 3 cups shredded cooked chicken 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers Directions:  Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Bake until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes 🎥: Nicole #mississippichickencasserole #chickencasserole #dinnerideas

Rest uncovered in the fridge for at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Seasoned Flour + Wet Batter: Mix AP flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cayenne, black pepper + pinch MSG. Move ~⅓ to another bowl and whisk with cold sparkling water until thin pancake batter. Double Dredge: Mix 1–2 tbsp wet batter into dry flour for craggly bits. Coat chicken: wet → dry → wet → dry (press to stick). Fry: 350°F oil for 4–6 mins until golden + CWISPY (and 165F internal). Honey BBQ Glaze: Heat BBQ sauce (Sweet Baby Ray’s), honey, butter, vinegar, hot sauce until smooth + glossy. Season to taste. Toss or brush chicken with glaze while it’s still hot. Mississippi Chicken❤️ Ingredients: Boneless skinless chicken breasts Seasonings of your choice Olive oil Butter Brown gravy packet  Ranch seasoning packet Chicken broth Onion  Bell pepper  Peperoncino peppers Minced garlic Directions: Clean and season chicken breasts. Sear in a pan with olive oil for 5 mins on each side, then place in a baking dish. Add a few pieces of butter and sliced onions and bell peppers on top of the chicken. In that same pan, add butter, minced garlic, diced onions, the brown gravy packet and the ranch packet, 2 cups of chicken broth (or 1 cup broth, 1 cup water. I use one of each) ❗️This is just an estimate though. It depends on how much chicken you have. The gravy should be soupy. It will thicken in the oven.❗️and 1/3 cup of the peperoncino juice (add more or less depending on how spicy you want it) Taste to see if you need to add seasoning to your gravy. Let that simmer. Then add to the dish. Cover and cook in the oven for 90 minutes to 2 hours on 400 (depending on the thickness of your chicken) Shred and serve over rice or mashed potatoes. videos.caption: During the 2022 World Cup Round of 16 match between Morocco and Spain, Achraf Hakimi scored a decisive Panenka penalty to secure Morocco's victory in the penalty shootout.  The match ended 0-0 after 120 minutes, leading to a penalty shootout. Hakimi, born in Spain but representing Morocco, stepped up to take the crucial penalty. He calmly executed a Panenka, dinking the ball down the middle of the goal, deceiving the Spanish goalkeeper Unai Simon and sealing Morocco's place in the quarterfinals.  Morocco won the penalty shootout 3-0, with Spain missing all three of their attempts. Hakimi's penalty, described as nerveless and outrageous, sparked wild celebrations among the Moroccan players and fans, marking a historic moment for the team. It was a particularly poignant moment for Hakimi, scoring against the country of his birth to send his parents' homeland into the next round of the World Cup.  This victory marked the first time Morocco had reached the World Cup quarterfinals, making them the first Arab nation to achieve this feat.

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Preheat the oven to 375°F. 2. In a large bowl, combine the olive oil, garlic, paprika, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Toss the chicken until evenly coated and let marinate for 20 minutes. 3. In a 9×13-inch baking dish, stir together the jasmine rice, olive oil, onion, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, pepper, and hot chicken broth. 4. Arrange the chicken thighs over the rice. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes. 5. Remove the foil and continue baking for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is golden and reaches 165°F. 6. Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the chicken and rice, let rest for 5–10 minutes, fluff the rice with a fork, garnish with parsley, and serve. #easydinner #onepotmeal #chickenthighs #dinnerinspo #dinneridea

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

videos.caption: Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chipotlechicken #highprotein #mealprep #healthyrecipes

🍠 High-Protein Sweet Potato Chicken Bowl (Serves 2) Healthy never has to be boring! This high-protein sweet potato bowl is packed with juicy chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, and roasted broccoli.    Ingredients: • 1 large sweet potato • 2 boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 2 cups broccoli florets • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp onion powder • ½ tsp cayenne pepper • ½ tsp chili powder • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper   Directions: 1️⃣ Roast the Sweet Potatoes   Season sweet potatoes with salt and pepper. Roast at 425°F for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until caramelized and tender. 2️⃣ Cook the Chicken   Season chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, chili powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Cook in a hot skillet over medium-high heat 10-12 minutes until juicy and tender.  3️⃣ Roast the Broccoli Roast broccoli at 425°F for 15 to 25 minutes until your liking. Season lightly with salt and pepper.  4️⃣ Build Your Bowl Layer your roasted sweet potatoes, chicken, and broccoli. Finish with a squeeze of lime and enjoy! #food #cooking #sweetpotatoes #protein #foodie

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. ENJOY! . . . . #grilledchicken #ricebowl #mealprep #healthyrecipes #chickenrecipes

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Chipotle Chicken Bowls 🍗🍚🌶️  Have you ever paid $18 or more for lunch? Showing you how to make homemade chipotle bowls with cilantro lime rice, double chicken, black beans, corn salsa, guacamole, and the delicious honey chipotle vinaigrette for $6 per serving! Not including the time waiting around for marinating, I was able to get these meals made and dishes all cleaned in less than an hour! I also get groceries delivered to the house for ease. I love eating out and buying lunch from time to time. Especially when in a rush, traveling, or a fun lunch date with my wife. But, I’m here to show you that you can also cook meals for yourself while making it healthy, affordable, and even enjoyable! mix well -marinade for at least 30 min up to overnight  -air fry at 400F for 20 min or bake at 400F for 30 min until internal temp is 165F -rest for 10 min; cut into bite-sized pieces  Cilantro Lime Rice 🍚 Ingredients: -1 1/2 cups uncooked white rice, rinsed,rinse -2 1/2 cups chicken bone broth  -dried bay leaf -3 limes  -1/2 cup chopped cilantro  -1 tsp olive oil -1/4 tsp lime zest  -salt to taste  Instructions: -add rice to rice cooker with broth and bay leaf -cook until fluffy; transfer to bowl -add oil, cilantro, lime zest and juice, and salt; mix well  Seasoned Black Beans 🫘 Ingredients: -1 cup eduncooked black beans, rinsed -3 cups water  -1 tbs tomato paste -1/2 tsp onion powder  -1/2 tsp garlic powder -1/2 tsp smoked paprika  -1/2 tsp ground cumin  -1/2 tsp dried oregano  -1/2 tsp salt -1/2 tsp black pepper -dried bay leaf  Instructions: -add all ingredients into pressure cooker; mix well -pressure cook for 30 min until tender  Corn Salsa 🌽 Ingredients: -1 15-oz. can unsalted corn  -half of a red onion, diced  -1 jalapeño, diced  -salt, cilantro, and lime juice to taste  Instructions: -add ingredients into a bowl; mix well  Fresh Guacamole 🥑 Ingredients: -3 ripe avocados  -half a red onion, diced -1 roma tomato, diced -1 jalapeño, diced  -salt, cilantro, and lime juice to taste  Instructions: -add avocado to a bowl and mash; mix in rest of ingredients  -transfer to a container, press plastic wrap against the surface, and cover with a tight lid  Chipotle Honey Vinaigrette 🍯  Ingredients:  -1/3 cup olive oil  -1/4 cup honey  -1/4 cup red wine vinegar  -1/2 tsp garlic powder  -1/2 tsp dried oregano  -1/4 tsp salt -1/4 tsp pepper  -1 chipotle pepper from the can  Instructions: -add all the ingredients into a large container  -use an immersion blender to blend until smooth #mealprep #chipotle #chicken #food #cooking

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice
